learning: Hypotheses: (1) bend line loss is a control-response limit at bend entry, so a slower entry reduces line_loss_events on the s-bend and slalom below 2.0 and 3.0; (2) kd 0.5 keeps steering_oscillation near 0.2 without losing the oval finish rate; (3) if line loss is unchanged at 2.0 and 3.0 with lower speed and higher kd, the limit is not speed or damping, and the remaining lever is a gain or line-loss strategy change. Report completion_time on the oval to check speed margin.
notes: Iteration-8 geometry unchanged. Controller changes only: base_speed 1.4 to 1.2 (slower bend entry) and kd 0.4 to 0.5 (more damping). Noise robustness added to observe signal quality under the controller change.
rationale: Iteration 8 (mass 0.5 kg, otherwise the iteration-4 layout) is the best design so far at 303.6. The oval finished 16 of 20 runs with a mean finish time of 1.86 s, so there is speed margin. The s-bend and slalom still ended off track in every run, with line_loss_events at 2.0 and 3.0. Span, forward position, footprint, track width and mass have all been tried around this layout without clearing bend line loss. The remaining hypothesis is a control-response limit at bend entry, so this iteration changes only the controller. I keep the iteration-8 geometry exactly, so any score change is attributable to control. Two controller changes: (a) base_speed 1.4 to 1.2. The bend failures are off-track losses, not a speed shortfall, and a slower entry gives the 0.04 to 0.075 m lookahead more time to correct. Expected oval mean finish time is about 1.86 x 1.4/1.2, roughly 2.2 s, still under the 3 s limit. (b) kd 0.4 to 0.5. Bend steering_oscillation is about 0.22 and kd damped the oval earlier (0.20 to 0.16 when kd went 0.3 to 0.4). kp (4.0), ki (0.1) and last_direction line loss are unchanged. Risk: a lower base_speed lengthens finish time, and higher kd may amplify sensor noise, so completion_time and steering_oscillation are the watch points. If the oval finish rate falls below 0.75 or the score falls below 303.6, the next design should return to base_speed 1.4 and kd 0.4.
